title: Infant Mortality Reduction by the Mass Administration of Azithromycin
brief_summary: This trial will investigate the supplementation of azithromycin distribution to the "Child Health Days" platform in Burkina Faso for child mortality reduction. This distribution will pair door-to-door administration of vitamin A and azithromycin or placebo with acute malnutrition screening among children 1-11 months old.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Community eligibility criteria:

* Located in one of the three selected regions: SudOuest, Centre-Ouest, Hauts-Bassins
* Verbal consent of the community leader is obtained

Inclusion criteria for children:

* Aged 1 to 11 months
* Living in one of the communities participating in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

Community exclusion criteria:

• Inaccessible or unsafe for the study team

Exclusion criteria for children:

• Known allergy to macrolides
